result_preview.title: Engineering Change Management API
result_preview.shortDescription: REST API for creating, approving, and tracking engineering changes across product designs.
result_preview.description: Exposes REST endpoints for managing engineering change orders (ECOs) throughout their lifecycle, including change request creation, stakeholder approval workflows, impact assessment on bill of materials, and compliance validation. Enables integration with downstream systems for synchronized product data updates and traceability.

result_preview.title: Design Modification and Component Specification API
result_preview.shortDescription: Facilitates tracking and coordination of design updates and component specifications during product development and procurement cycles.
result_preview.description: Exposes design modification records and component specification data to enable integration systems to access approval statuses, impacted items, and change history throughout the product lifecycle. Supports retrieval of design update details, affected component relationships, and change request submissions to coordinate cross-functional teams. Enables real-time access to modification tracking, impact assessments, and stakeholder notifications for design changes across sourcing and manufacturing operations.

result_preview.title: Engineering Change and Compliance Orchestrator
result_preview.shortDescription: Automates change request workflows, equipment impact assessments, and compliance validation across product lifecycle.
result_preview.description: Monitors and coordinates engineering change requests through design review cycles, automatically assesses affected IT equipment and digital twin configurations, and processes compliance documentation requirements. Routes service tickets to appropriate teams based on change criticality and regulatory impact, ensuring supplier qualification updates and cost estimation workflows are triggered seamlessly throughout the product development lifecycle.
